A politikus, aki ugyanúgy fog hiányozni Trumpnak, mint Zelenszkijnek
estonia.description: A külpolitikában is nagy befolyású Lindsey Graham szenátor azon kevesek között volt, akik érdemben tudtak hatni Trumpra. Hitt a transzatlanti szövetségben és Ukrajna is sokat köszönhet neki, halála előtt órákkal érkezett haza Kijevből. De abban is nagy szerepe volt, hogy Trump megindította az iráni háborút, amiből nem tud kimászni.

estonia.title: Schobert Norbert reagált az országos tiszti főorvos felhívására: Egy családapa vagyok, aki küzd a szerelme életéért
estonia.description: Oroszi Beatrix arra kérte a közéleti szereplőket, hogy egészségügyi témákban különös felelősséggel járjanak el.

estonia.title: Exkluzivní průzkum: Opozice summitem v Ankaře nic nezískala, naopak
estonia.description: Politici opozičních stran několik měsíců hojně komentovali spor prezidenta Petra Pavla a vlády Andreje Babiše (ANO) o to, kdo měl jet na červencový summit NATO v Ankaře. Politické body si však opozice díky tomu nepřipsala, naopak dokonce tratila. Zatímco vnímání prezidenta se zlepšilo u téměř čtvrtiny respondentů a vnímání kabinetu u více než patnácti procent, opozici hodnotí lépe než před summitem pouhých devět procent dotázaných. Ukázal to exkluzivní průzkum agentury NMS pro Novinky.

estonia.title: Lidem se na loukách na Opavsku podařilo natočit velmi vzácné ptáky
estonia.description: Ohromující množství v Česku vzácných druhů ptáků se letos na jaře objevilo na Opavsku na Kozmických ptačích loukách. Lidé zde spatřili v jeden časový okamžik až tři tisíce ptáků. Některé se jim podařilo dokonce natočit, jako např. kolpíka bílého. Pozorovali ale i lžičáky, ostralky, břehouše, orla mořského, volavku stříbřitou, ale také moudivláčka. Některé zachycené druhy jsou v Česku raritou či jsou kriticky ohrožené.

estonia.title: Petrișor Peiu (AUR): Nicuşor Dan secretizează o parte din cheltuielile publice, Constituţia nu-i oferă acest drept
estonia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR Petrişor Peiu îl critică pe preşedintele Nicuşor Dan pentru „refuzul” de a face publică valoarea ajutorului financiar acordat de România Ucrainei.

estonia.title: Declarația summitului de la Kiev: Liderii europeni susțin aderarea Ucrainei la UE și NATO și cer retragerea trupelor ruse
estonia.description: Liderii participanți la cea de-a cincea ediție a Summitului Ucraina – Europa de Sud-Est, desfășurat la Kiev, au adoptat o declarație comună prin care condamnă ferm agresiunea militară a Rusiei și își reafirmă sprijinul pentru independența, suveranitatea și integritatea teritorială a Ucrainei. Documentul subliniază că pacea trebuie să fie „cuprinzătoare, justă și durabilă”, bazată pe dreptul internațional și pe Carta ONU.

estonia.title: Vânătoarea din Marea Neagră. Ucraina ar fi distrus într-o singură noapte 17 petroliere și 2 nave cu gaz ale Rusiei
estonia.description: Dronele Forțelor Sistemelor Fără Pilot din Ucraina (FSF) au demarat o campanie sistematică de atacuri asupra navelor de transport rusești din Marea Neagră, după ce, în ultimele nouă zile, au lovit 116 petroliere și alte ambarcațiuni în apele Mării Azov.

estonia.title: Lituania avertizează asupra unor posibile provocări din partea Rusiei: „Am primit astfel de semnale de la serviciile de informații”
estonia.description: Președintele Lituaniei, Gitanas Nauseda, afirmă că informațiile serviciilor secrete indică faptul că Rusia ar putea planifica provocări în Polonia sau în țările baltice, menite să testeze unitatea NATO, relatează Reuters și LRT.

estonia.title: România și alte opt state cer UE să taie finanțarea organizațiilor sportive care acceptă sportivi din Rusia și Belarus
estonia.description: Nouă state europene, inclusiv România, au cerut Uniunii Europene să reducă finanțarea acordată organizațiilor sportive, printre care și Comitetul Internațional Olimpic (CIO), care permit participarea în competiții a sportivilor din Rusia și Belarus, a anunțat marți Ministerul Culturii din Estonia, scrie Reuters.

estonia.title: Saaremaa Opera Days open in the courtyard of Kuressaare Castle
estonia.description: The 19th Saaremaa Opera Days begin in the Kuressaare Castle courtyard, running from July 18 to 25. This year's headliner is Italy's Livorno Goldoni Opera House, while Estonia's top soloists will appear in the first part of Richard Wagner's opera tetralogy "The Ring of the Nibelung", "Das Rheingold", staged jointly by Eesti Kontsert and the National Theatre Vanemuine.

estonia.title: Prime minister: Estonia can fund defense and still cut spending
estonia.description: Estonia must continue cuts as real talks over budget begin in late summer, despite competing spending demands, Prime Minister Kristen Michal (Reform Party) said in an interview.

estonia.title: US 'close' to resuming weapons deliveries, says Estonian officials
estonia.description: Estonia's ambassador in Washington has said the US is "close" to resuming weapons deliveries, which were suspended after the start of the war in Iran this spring. Minister of Defense Hanno Pevkur (Reform) said they would arrive in the "coming months."

estonia.title: Estonia's cinema attendance up 9,000 in first half of 2026
estonia.description: The first half of this year brought 1,259,717 visitors to Estonian cinemas, about a 0.7‑percent increase from the same period in 2025.

estonia.title: Highest UV index reading in Estonia recorded in Haapsalu
estonia.description: The highest ultraviolet (UV) index ever measured in Estonia was recorded in Haapsalu last month, while a reading nearly as high was taken in Pärnu at the same time.

estonia.title: Tallinn Airport sets new record, but fewer Estonians are traveling this year
estonia.description: Tallinn Airport served 373,000 passengers in June, setting a new all-time record. At the same time, travel agencies say they are seeing fewer customers and attribute the decline to the economic situation.

estonia.title: Kristina Schotter: The limits of the prescription drug advertising ban need clarity
estonia.description: A recent weight‑loss campaign drew public attention to the question of where a permitted health campaign ends and prohibited prescription drug advertising begins. The rules should be clearly worded, not vague, writes Kristina Schotter.

estonia.title: A first for Estonia: Fully electric aircraft lands at Tartu Airport
estonia.description: Aviation history was made at Tartu Airport on Wednesday when the Elektra Trainer, a fully certified electric airplane, landed after a flight from Helsinki.

estonia.title: Rally Estonia brings flight restrictions to south of the country
estonia.description: Rally Estonia starts today, Thursday and the airspace above restricted areas relating to the race are closed to unauthorized air traffic, both piloted and remotely controlled.

estonia.title: Elering tests reliability of Estonia's power system
estonia.description: Estonian grid operator Elering carried out a technical test of the power system on Wednesday, known as a black‑start test, to check readiness for situations where part of the grid must temporarily operate separately from the rest of the system.

estonia.title: Young birds on the move increase summer hazards for Estonia's drivers
estonia.description: Drivers are being urged to stay vigilant as fledgling birds, including flightless waterfowl, are appearing alongside—and sometimes on—Estonia's roads.

estonia.title: Food delivery apps must offer reusable packaging option from 2028
estonia.description: Food delivery apps will have to offer customers the option of reusable packaging from 2028 under new rules accompanying EU packaging legislation.

estonia.title: Plan for paid alcohol permits could reduce Estonia's outlet count
estonia.description: The Ministry of Social Affairs is weighing whether to introduce fees for alcohol sales permits, which are currently issued free of charge, in an effort to limit the record number of sales outlets.

estonia.title: Court fight over Eurovision song could complicate music teaching and live shows
estonia.description: A court dispute between composer Ivar Must and the Estonian Film Institute over a modified performance of the Eurovision song "Everybody" raises concerns that any changes to musical works may require direct author approval.

estonia.title: Estonia mulls extending statute of limitations for crimes against children
estonia.description: The Ministry of Justice has developed a plan to extend the period of time a victim of child abuse can report a crime against them from the current 10-years to 32 years or until the victim turns 50 years old.

estonia.title: Gaea Schoeters: Colonialism is still part of our culture
estonia.description: Belgian author and screenwriter Gaea Schoeters took part a conversation at the HeadRead literary festival earlier this year, discussing language, translation and the power of fiction.

estonia.title: Hans Väre: But perhaps rules do have a reason after all
estonia.description: Most people would agree that a green‑fingered neighbour selling surplus potatoes and pumpkins from the backyard, or a schoolkid offering homemade lemonade, should not get caught in the gears of bureaucracy. But there must always be a limit somewhere, writes Hans Väre.

estonia.title: Tallinna FC Flora out of UEFA Champions League
estonia.description: Estonian Meistriliiga team Tallinn FC Flora's 2-2 away draw against Georgian side FC Iberia 1999 in the second leg of their Champions League qualifier round one tie was not enough to keep them in the running.

estonia.title: Sweden's Hanza buys metalworking factory in Narva from Finland's Fortaco
estonia.description: Swedish manufacturer Hanza will buy a metalworking plant in Estonia's Narva, employing 400 people, and will become one of the biggest employers in the eastern border city.

estonia.title: Transport authority: Majority of drivers in Estonia ignore traffic lights
estonia.description: Over half of drivers in Estonia ignore red and amber traffic lights, according to a recent study.

estonia.title: High‑earning fathers most likely to use Estonia's parental benefit while continuing to work
estonia.description: Estonia's flexible parental‑leave rules often allow high‑earning fathers to collect benefits while continuing to work, a pattern researchers say can undermine the policy's original goal of letting one parent step back from employment to care for a newborn.

estonia.title: Research center: Milk, butter prices in Estonia continue to fall
estonia.description: The price of both milk and butter fell in the second quarter of 2026 (Q2 2026), data from the Center of Estonian Rural Research and Knowledge (METK) shows.

estonia.title: Archaeologists find papal seal in a courtyard in central Tallinn
estonia.description: Archaeological excavations began last year in the courtyard and surrounding area of a Soviet‑era office building on Rävala puiestee in Tallinn. On Tuesday, the team uncovered a papal bulla — a seal — dating from the 14th century and issued by Pope Clement V.

estonia.title: Ardo Hansson: The importunate chink of grasshoppers and the silent majority
estonia.description: Personal difficulties and general satisfaction can exist simultaneously in any country. Eurobarometer results suggest that this is exactly the case in Estonia today, writes Ardo Hansson.

estonia.title: Grüne Fee CEO: EU plastics rules could cut fruit and vegetable choice
estonia.description: A European Union ban on individually plastic-wrapped vegetables may lead to many types of fruit and vegetables disappearing from supermarket shelves in Estonia, an industry leader has said.

estonia.title: Reform MPs outline more than €100 million in potential budget cuts
estonia.description: Two Reform Party lawmakers say Estonia could save more than €100 million by delaying major cultural projects, reducing income‑tax transfers to wealthy municipalities and trimming public‑sector benefits. Far larger cuts would still be needed to meet the party's deficit target.

estonia.title: Two squirrel bridges installed in Tartu
estonia.description: Squirrel bridges were constructed near the Tähtvere and Kassitoome parks in Tartu. If they prove effective, similar ones could appear across Estonia.

estonia.title: Dorm living remains far cheaper for students as Tallinn rental prices stay high
estonia.description: Most Tallinn universities begin accepting dormitory applications in the second half of July, and generally all first‑year students who apply on time receive a place.

estonia.title: Man carrying deactivated machine gun in Tallinn has weapon confiscated
estonia.description: A machine gun being carried openly by a man walking around Tallinn's Old Town over the weekend turned out to be a deactivated model, Delfi reported.

estonia.title: Restaurateurs in Estonia facing 'toughest conditions in 30 years'
estonia.description: Restaurants in Estonia say they are facing their toughest situation in three decades.

estonia.title: Poll: SDE's rating surge stalls
estonia.description: A recent boost in support for the opposition Social Democratic Party has come to an end, the latest weekly survey by MTÜ Ühiskonnauuringute Instituut and research firm Norstat Eesti AS shows.

estonia.title: Estonian troops join Bastille Day parade in Paris
estonia.description: Estonian Defense Forces (EDF) personnel took part in this year's Bastille Day parade before President Emmanuel Macron in Paris on Tuesday.

estonia.title: SEB Bank chief: Estonia's economy showing early recovery
estonia.description: There are signs of recovery in Estonia's economy, SEB Bank chairman Allan Parik said while commenting on the bank's first‑half results. SEB Bank Group ended the first half of 2026 with a profit of €83.8 million, slightly below the €86.2 million earned in the first half of 2025.

estonia.title: Foreign seasonal workers in Estonia mainly head to agricultural jobs
estonia.description: Seasonal farm work continues to draw most of Estonia's short‑term foreign labor, as authorities report 2,396 arrivals so far this year — a noticeable decline from recent years.

estonia.title: Estonia sees tourist boost in May
estonia.description: Accommodation establishments served nearly 320,300 tourists in May 2026, which is 5 percent more than in May last year, according to Statistics Estonia

estonia.title: Footballer Rocco Shein signed by Portsmouth FC in one of biggest ever Estonian transfers
estonia.description: National team midfielder Rocco Shein has signed for English Championship side Portsmouth for €2.4 million, one of the highest fees ever commanded for an Estonian player.

estonia.title: Heavy rain slows work on Estonia's eastern border
estonia.description: Last week's heavy rain has slowed construction on one section of the eastern border in south Estonia and the work will now need to be redone.

estonia.title: Estonia helping Armenian local governments tackle corruption
estonia.description: The Estonian Centre for International Development and Transparency International Estonia are developing a system to help Armenia in corruption risk assessment, as corruption remains a challenge for local governments.

estonia.title: Gallery: Top US and British acts close out Kikumu festival
estonia.description: US singer-songwriter Panda Bear and Britain's Sonic Boom headlined the final day of the Kikumu film, art and music festival Sunday.

estonia.title: Deputy mayor: Lastekodu street redesign created confusion for traffic
estonia.description: Traffic-calming measures at a recently refurbished central Tallinn street are confusing and were unnecessarily expensive, Deputy Mayor Kristjan Järvan (Isamaa) said.

estonia.title: Russia plans to take Baltics to International Court of Justice over alleged discrimination
estonia.description: Russia has plans to take the Baltic states to the International Court of Justice, accusing them of discriminating against ethnic Russians, in what would likely become Estonia's most expensive court case to date, Baltic investigative journalists have found.

estonia.title: Students say festival attendance limited by rising prices and extra expense
estonia.description: Estonian summer festivals are confronting higher costs and raising ticket prices to stay afloat.

estonia.title: Estonia weighs limits on bulk communications‑data retention
estonia.description: Justice and Digital Minister Liisa Pakosta (Eesti 200) sent the government a draft law that would end telecom companies' obligation to collect people's communications data on a mass scale at the state's request.

estonia.title: Estonia–Ukraine drone deal implementation 'begins immediately'
estonia.description: More than 10 Ukrainian companies are ready to move their production to Estonia, Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur said. Estonia hopes to use its newly signed drone cooperation agreement with Ukraine to procure advanced weaponry more broadly than just unmanned systems.

estonia.title: Tallinn Christmas market 2026 once again to be run by longtime operator
estonia.description: A company which has operated Tallinn's annual Christmas market has once again won the tender to do so for 2026.

estonia.title: Watch | Stefan Hedlund: You can't have a rational discourse with people who love Russia
estonia.description: Swedish academic and historian Stefan Hedlund said in a conversation at the Headread festival in Tallinn that the greatest favor we can do Ukrainians right now is to acknowledge that Ukraine exists because the Russians have refused to accept it.

estonia.title: Estonia's most expensive apartment ever sells for €4 million
estonia.description: A Tallinn apartment which recently sold for €4 million is reportedly the most expensive transaction in Estonian real estate history.

estonia.title: Pärnu and local governments support tourist tax, but Tallinn against
estonia.description: Summer capital Pärnu and the association of local authorities believe introducing a new tax on tourists would be beneficial, but officials in Tallinn think it would damage tourism.

estonia.title: Tallink's chief captain: Modern passenger ships built to survive any accident
estonia.description: Tallink's chief captain Tarvi‑Carlos Tuulik says a major leap in ship safety occurred 10–12 years ago, when new requirements were introduced mandating that passenger ships must be built so they can return to port on their own after any accident.

estonia.title: Go3 warns proposed Estonian streaming rules could limit investments
estonia.description: A planned 5-percent investment requirement for audiovisual content could harm Estonia's streaming market and domestic production, stakeholders say.

estonia.title: Kaitsekulude suurendamine haukab tüki puuetega inimeste toetamisest
estonia.description: Kärped sunnivad järgnevatel aastatel mitut mittetulundusühingut tuntavalt väiksema eelarvega toimetama.

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Venemaa lennukid ei suutnud peatada Ukraina meredroone ja tabamuse said kaks naftatankerit
estonia.description: Ukraina Julgeolekuteenistus (SSU) teatas 16. juulil, et koostöös mereväega tabasid nende Mamai nime kandvad meredroonid Mustal merel kahte tankerit – Louise 1 ja Banda. Ukraina andmetel kuuluvad mõlemad niinimetatud Venemaa varilaevastikku.

estonia.title: Teadlased avastasid, et see puuvili kaitseb nahka päikese eest
estonia.description: Mõte puuviljast, mis teeb kehas rakutasandil ümberkorraldusi, kõlab kui ulmefilm. Värske teadustöö aga kinnitab, et viinamarjade söömine pole pelgalt maitseelamus, vaid tõhus viis naha ja kogu organismi geneetilise kella ümberseadistamiseks.

estonia.title: REIN LANG ⟩ Rahvusooperi eestvedajad meenutavad burlakke Volgal
estonia.description: Iga järjekordne uudis rahvusooper Estonia kohta toob mulle silme ette ukraina päritolu maalikunstniku Ilja Repini 1873. aasta maali «Burlakid Volgal». Sellel on kujutatud mehi, kes veavad köite abil vastuvoolu pargast. Ebainimlik töö. Aga mille poolest erinevad maalil kujutatud õnnetud neist, kes läbi ajaloo lohistavad vastuvoolu enda järel probleemi nimega rahvusooper, küsib Eesti Ringhäälingute Liidu juht Rein Lang (Reformierakond).

estonia.title: Plaanid reisida? Uuringu kohaselt on need riigid maailma kõige sõbralikumad
estonia.description: Sõbralik vastuvõtt, turvaline keskkond ja avatud suhtumine võivad muuta reisimise märksa meeldivamaks. Rahvusvahelise ravikindlustusettevõtte William Russell koostatud värske edetabel tõi välja riigid ja linnad, kus välismaalased tunnevad end kõige teretulnumana.

estonia.title: ARMAS KLÕPS ⟩ Koit Toome ja Kaia Triisa näitavad unistuste suveõhtut merel – paadiga teatrisse ja tagasi päikeseloojangusse
estonia.description: Koit Toome avaldas sotsiaalmeedias suvise hetke Kaia Triisaga. Päev viis paari Naissaarele, kus nad käisid vaatamas Nargenfestivali lavastust «Turbulents».

estonia.title: Eestlane alustab uut peatükki: Indrek Palm asus juhtima Malta rannajalgpalli koondist
estonia.description: Endine Eesti rannajalgpallikoondise mängija Indrek Palm alustab oma treenerikarjääris uut ja märgilist peatükki, asudes juhtima Malta rannajalgpallikoondist. Eestlane sõnas, et võimalus juhendada välisriigi rahvuskoondist oli väljakutse, millest ta ei tahtnud loobuda.

estonia.title: Need superhiired ja -rotid ainult muigavad mürkide peale – mis on juhtunud?
estonia.description: Hiired, rotid ja muud kahjurid on probleem nii maakohtades kui paljudes suurtes linnades. Nad võivad kanda haigusi ja seeläbi inimeste tervist ohustada. Paraku tundub, et nad muutuvad mürkide suhtes aina resistentsemaks.

estonia.title: ANALÜÜS ⟩ Kuidas tuleb Ukraina välja kriisist, mille põhjustas Zelenskõi otsus vallandada kaitseminister?
estonia.description: Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi algatas valitsusevahetuse, kuid ei näe uue kabinetis kohta kaitseminister Mõhhailo Fedorovile. See ajas ukrainlased vihale ja tõi nad tänavale. Küsimus on, kas parlamendis saadakse kokku hääled uue kaitseministri ametisse kinnitamiseks ja kuidas Ukraina sellest kriisist nüüd välja tuleb?

estonia.title: Läänemaa päästjad tõid haisvast pimedusest välja kohutavas seisundis kassikoloonia
estonia.description: Haapsalus päästeti kahest garaažiboksist kokku 20 kehvas seisus kassi. Loomade päästmiseks pidid päästjad avama garaažide tabalukud ning appi kaasati nii politsei kui ka loomapäästjad.

estonia.title: Amet heidab Eesti Raudteele ette uute raudteeületuskohtade rajamise takistamist
estonia.description: Tarbijakaitse ja tehnilise järelevalve amet süüdistab Eesti Raudteed uute samatasandiliste raudteeülekäigukohtade rajamise põhjendamatus takistamises ning palub kliimaministeeriumil võtta seisukoht.

estonia.title: Jäätiseraamatu autor: poole aastaga kukkus kümme kilo nagu kolinal ja ma ei pidanud magusast loobuma
estonia.description: 15. juulil esitles Dalia Patrael Tartus Apollo raamatupoes värsket kokaraamatut «Ninja Creami jäätised», kuhu on kogutud 50 tervisliku jäätise retsepti. Autori selgitusel sobivad retseptid neile, kes soovivad treeningeesmärke silmas pidades toitainelisel jaotusel ja kaloraažil silma peal hoida, kaalu langetada või lihtsalt terviseteadlikumalt maiustada.

estonia.title: Klassika uues võtmes: suvised sõrnikud sidruni ja mustikatega
estonia.description: Kui tavapärased sõrnikud tunduvad liiga rasked, tasub proovida vähe värskemat varianti.

estonia.title: USKUMATU KADUMINE ⟩ WebZetty OÜ 750 miljoni euro suurune käive muutus pärast «Kuuuurija» päringut
estonia.description: Veel mõni päev tagasi näitasid avalikud ettevõtlusandmed, et WebZetty OÜ oli 2026. aasta esimeses kvartalis deklareerinud ligi 750 miljoni euro suuruse maksustatava käibe – rohkem kui Eesti Energial samal perioodil. Kui «Kuuuurija» püüdis ettevõttelt selgitusi saada ja pöördus küsimustega maksu- ja tolliameti poole, selgus, et värsketes avaandmetes oli ettevõtte käive hoopis 228 710 eurot.

estonia.title: RÄNDERÜNNE VALGEVENEST ⟩ Eesti ei kaalu piirikontrolli taastamist Lätiga
estonia.description: Eesti ei ole erinevalt Leedust kaalunud migrandisurve kasvu tõttu piirikontrolli taastamist Lätiga ning on pigem valmis minema lõunanaabritele appi Euroopa Liidu välispiirile ebaseadusikke sisserändajaid tõrjuma.

estonia.title: Eesti perefirma omandas Läti kodumasinate müüja
estonia.description: Perekond Vipside kuuluv hulgimüügiettevõte AbeStock omandas Läti ettevõtte B.T.U. Company, et tugevdada oma väikeste kodumasinate ärisuunda Baltikumis

estonia.title: VILJANDI FOLK ⟩ Tõnis Mägi: esitan festivalil laule, mõeldes Jaak Johansonile
estonia.description: 23. juulil, Viljandi folgi esimesel õhtul, astub Tõnis Mägi üles Jaak Johansoni nimelisel laval, kus esinevad artistid, kelle looming jääb väljapoole pärimusmuusikat. Sel laval esinemine on Mäe jaoks väga tähenduslik. Just Jaak Johanson nii muusiku kui ka isiksusena loob Mäele tugeva sideme Viljandi folgiga. Johansoni igakülgset silmapaistvust, mida ta elu jooksul kogeda jõudis, meenutabki Mägi nüüd peatselt saabuva festivali eel.

latvia.title: A politikus, aki ugyanúgy fog hiányozni Trumpnak, mint Zelenszkijnek
latvia.description: A külpolitikában is nagy befolyású Lindsey Graham szenátor azon kevesek között volt, akik érdemben tudtak hatni Trumpra. Hitt a transzatlanti szövetségben és Ukrajna is sokat köszönhet neki, halála előtt órákkal érkezett haza Kijevből. De abban is nagy szerepe volt, hogy Trump megindította az iráni háborút, amiből nem tud kimászni.

latvia.title: „Nem is dolgozhattak volna keményebben” – a fájdalmas vereség után is bízik Tuchelben az angol futballszövetség
latvia.description: Az FA vezérigazgatója szerint a játékosok és a szövetségi kapitány ezúttal is mindent beleadtak.

latvia.title: Új vezetőt neveztek ki a Diákhitel Központ élére
latvia.description: Megszűnt Bugár Csaba elnök-vezérigazgató megbízatása, de már az utódja is megvan.

latvia.title: Schobert Norbert reagált az országos tiszti főorvos felhívására: Egy családapa vagyok, aki küzd a szerelme életéért
latvia.description: Oroszi Beatrix arra kérte a közéleti szereplőket, hogy egészségügyi témákban különös felelősséggel járjanak el.

latvia.title: Megtámadták Kijevet, heves tiltakozást robbantott ki Zelenszkij húzása – Percről percre híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról csütörtökön
latvia.description: Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök a Naftohaz állami energetikai vállalat vezérigazgatóját, Szerhij Koreckijt jelölte Ukrajna új miniszterelnökének a háború közepette végrehajtott kormányátalakítás részeként. Koreckij kinevezését ma szavazta meg az ukrán parlament. Távozik posztjáról Mihajlo Fedorov védelmi miniszter is. Zelenszkij döntése tüntetésekhez vezetett, több ukrán politikus bírálta a népszerű Fedorov leváltását. Oroszország ma éjszaka ballisztikus rakétákkal támadta Ukrajna fővárosát, legalább két ember meghalt és hatan megsebesültek. Kijevet helyi idő szerint hajnali 1 óra előtt rázták meg robbanások a Kyiv Independent tudósítói szerint. Az ukrán légierő jelentése alapján legalább nyolc ballisztikus rakéta tartott a főváros felé. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül a legutóbbi fejleményekkel.

latvia.title: Kimondta Ukrajna új miniszterelnöke: nehezebb időszak fenyegeti az országot, mint korábban
latvia.description: Szerhij Koreckij, a Naftohaz ukrán állami kőolaj- és földgázipari vállalat volt vezérigazgatója, Ukrajna új miniszterelnöke parlamenti beszédében arra figyelmeztetett, hogy a következő tél még a korábbiaknál is komolyabb kihívás elé állíthatja az országot, így az érkező kormány egyik legfontosabb feladata az erre való felkészülés lesz - számol be az Ukrajinszka Pravda.

latvia.title: Most már hivatalos: új politikus került Ukrajna élére
latvia.description: Az ukrán parlament csütörtökön elfogadta Szerhij Koreckij kormányfői kinevezését. A Naftohaz állami energetikai vállalat vezérigazgatóját Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök jelölte a miniszterelnöki tisztségre.

latvia.title: Kiderült, hogyan állnak a magyar gáztárolók a tél előtt
latvia.description: A gáztárolók feltöltése jelentősen felgyorsult: az előzetes adatok szerint július közepére a hazai tárolók töltöttsége elérte az 55 százalékot, ami gyakorlatilag megegyezik az egy évvel korábbi szinttel - olvasható Ferencz I. Szabolcs, az FGSZ Zrt. elnök-vezérigazgatójának posztjában .

latvia.title: Exkluzivní průzkum: Opozice summitem v Ankaře nic nezískala, naopak
latvia.description: Politici opozičních stran několik měsíců hojně komentovali spor prezidenta Petra Pavla a vlády Andreje Babiše (ANO) o to, kdo měl jet na červencový summit NATO v Ankaře. Politické body si však opozice díky tomu nepřipsala, naopak dokonce tratila. Zatímco vnímání prezidenta se zlepšilo u téměř čtvrtiny respondentů a vnímání kabinetu u více než patnácti procent, opozici hodnotí lépe než před summitem pouhých devět procent dotázaných. Ukázal to exkluzivní průzkum agentury NMS pro Novinky.

latvia.title: Lidem se na loukách na Opavsku podařilo natočit velmi vzácné ptáky
latvia.description: Ohromující množství v Česku vzácných druhů ptáků se letos na jaře objevilo na Opavsku na Kozmických ptačích loukách. Lidé zde spatřili v jeden časový okamžik až tři tisíce ptáků. Některé se jim podařilo dokonce natočit, jako např. kolpíka bílého. Pozorovali ale i lžičáky, ostralky, břehouše, orla mořského, volavku stříbřitou, ale také moudivláčka. Některé zachycené druhy jsou v Česku raritou či jsou kriticky ohrožené.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu (AUR): Nicuşor Dan secretizează o parte din cheltuielile publice, Constituţia nu-i oferă acest drept
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR Petrişor Peiu îl critică pe preşedintele Nicuşor Dan pentru „refuzul” de a face publică valoarea ajutorului financiar acordat de România Ucrainei.

latvia.title: Declarația summitului de la Kiev: Liderii europeni susțin aderarea Ucrainei la UE și NATO și cer retragerea trupelor ruse
latvia.description: Liderii participanți la cea de-a cincea ediție a Summitului Ucraina – Europa de Sud-Est, desfășurat la Kiev, au adoptat o declarație comună prin care condamnă ferm agresiunea militară a Rusiei și își reafirmă sprijinul pentru independența, suveranitatea și integritatea teritorială a Ucrainei. Documentul subliniază că pacea trebuie să fie „cuprinzătoare, justă și durabilă”, bazată pe dreptul internațional și pe Carta ONU.

latvia.title: Vânătoarea din Marea Neagră. Ucraina ar fi distrus într-o singură noapte 17 petroliere și 2 nave cu gaz ale Rusiei
latvia.description: Dronele Forțelor Sistemelor Fără Pilot din Ucraina (FSF) au demarat o campanie sistematică de atacuri asupra navelor de transport rusești din Marea Neagră, după ce, în ultimele nouă zile, au lovit 116 petroliere și alte ambarcațiuni în apele Mării Azov.

latvia.title: Lituania avertizează asupra unor posibile provocări din partea Rusiei: „Am primit astfel de semnale de la serviciile de informații”
latvia.description: Președintele Lituaniei, Gitanas Nauseda, afirmă că informațiile serviciilor secrete indică faptul că Rusia ar putea planifica provocări în Polonia sau în țările baltice, menite să testeze unitatea NATO, relatează Reuters și LRT.

latvia.description: Ukraina Julgeolekuteenistus (SSU) teatas 16. juulil, et koostöös mereväega tabasid nende Mamai nime kandvad meredroonid Mustal merel kahte tankerit – Louise 1 ja Banda. Ukraina andmetel kuuluvad mõlemad niinimetatud Venemaa varilaevastikku.

latvia.title: Asendusemaduse lubamise vastu olnud Saksa tipp-poliitik sai surrogaadi abiga lapse
latvia.description: Saksamaa võimupartei parlamendifraktsiooni esimehe elus toimus tähtis sündmus, kui ta teatas sel nädalal sai isaks. Samast soost partneriga koos elavat poliitikut saadab kriitika, kuna lapse tõi ilmale surrogaatema. Selline lapse saamise viis on Saksamaal keelatud.

latvia.title: Small demonstration staged against closure of sports school
latvia.description: Around 20 people gathered outside the Ministry of Education and Science (IZM) building in Old Riga on Thursday morning to protest against the closure of the Jūrmala branch of the Murjāņi Sports Gymnasium (MSĢ).

latvia.title: Media speculates about airBaltic short-term financing
latvia.description: Latvian national airline airBaltic plans to seek short-term financing from bondholders, reports LSM's Latvian language service, which in turn cites the LETA newswire, which in turn cites Reuters, which cites a company statement.

latvia.title: New tourism brochure available for Valmiera district
latvia.description: As the tourist season hits its peak, Valmiera district in northern Latvia has prepared a new booklet outlining its active tourism offerings that may be of interest to foreign visitors as it is available in English.

latvia.title: Rīga to get a few more cycle lanes
latvia.description: To improve the availability of cycling infrastructure and promote safe cycling in the centre of the Latvian capital, Riga Municipality plans to create new sections of cycle lanes on Lāčplēša, Marijas, Šarlotes and Dzirnavu streets.

latvia.title: Almost a quarter of 'Latgale' election candidates live elsewhere
latvia.description: In the 15th Saeima elections, which are due to take place on October 3rd, there are fewer candidates standing in the eastern Latgale region than four years ago, and around one in four of those that are standing don't even live in the region.

latvia.title: Young Latvians lag behind neighbours in digital skills
latvia.description: In 2025, 74.6% of young people aged 16-24 in the EU had at least basic digital skills, according to data published by Eurostat on July 15th.

latvia.title: Liepāja advances in UEFA Conference League qualification
latvia.description: The football players of FK Liepāja won their second leg of the UEFA Conference League qualifying round first leg in Montenegro on Wednesday night and as a result secured a place in the second round of competition.

latvia.title: Auditors deliver damning report on Ogre district procurement practices
latvia.description: Ogre district municipality has not ensured transparent and responsible management of public funds, the State Audit Office (Valsts kontrole/VK) has concluded in an audit.

latvia.title: Researchers in Latvia concerned about potential threat to academic freedom
latvia.description: Researchers are expressing concerns about a possible threat to academic freedom after learning that the Saeima plans to discuss the usefulness of certain research.

latvia.title: Rinkēvičs: Latvia and Lithuanuia share 'a bond based on bloodline'
latvia.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs continues his two-day visit to Lithuania on July 16th, as previously reported.

latvia.title: High hopes for ten turtles released into the wild in Latvia
latvia.description: Ten European turtles were released into the Ruģeļi wetland in Daugavpils on July 15th as part of an ambitious rewilding project, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 15th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia tweaks its military national service rules
latvia.description: On Tuesday, July 14th, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a draft law developed by the Ministry of Defence, which aims to improve the regulation of the State Defence Service (VAD) – Latvia's system of compulsory military conscription – based on the experience gained during the first six intakes.

latvia.title: Rīga bridge repairs likely to cause traffic disruption
latvia.description: During the extensive renovation of the Vanšu Bridge in central Rīga the carriageway could be completely closed to private vehicles with only public transport and emergency services able to use it.

latvia.title: Baltics and Poland warn again about potential Russian provocations
latvia.description: Lithuania has intelligence information indicating that Russia may be preparing to carry out provocations of some sort in the Baltic region, Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda said in an interview with the BNS news agency.

latvia.title: Carnikava may soon become a city
latvia.description: The village of Carnikava should be granted city status, the Saeima's State Administration and Local Government Committee decided on Wednesday, July 15th. The draft law has been given urgency, and it is planned that the law will come into force on August 22 to coincide with local festival celebrations.

latvia.title: LRT: Lithuania considering reintroducing checks on Latvian border
latvia.description: Lithuania's incoming Interior Minister Martynas Katelynas has not ruled out temporarily reintroducing border controls with Latvia as the number of migrants arriving from Belarus via Latvia continues to increase. Compared with the first half of last year, secondary migration from Latvia has risen fourfold, reports Lithuanian public media LRT.

latvia.title: Why did Daugavpils sell its buses? It's complicated
latvia.description: Daugavpils City Municipality-owned company SIA "Daugavpils autobusu parks" (Daugavpils bus park) has been sold for 1.48 million euros to SIA "RTS grupa". The deal has not yet been finalized, but the municipality has emphasized that no significant changes are expected for passengers - buses will continue to run according to the current schedule, as the transportation contract concluded with the state remains in force.

latvia.title: Latvia's Baiba Braže attending Rubio-called conference in Washington, D.C.
latvia.description: Latvian Foreign Minister Baiba Braže is in Washington, D.C. on July 15th and 16th "to attend a conference of foreign ministers hosted by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio," according to a brief release by the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

latvia.title: Rēzekne to host second 'Dual-Use Export Forum'
latvia.description: Latvia's eastern city of Rēzekne will host the second “Latvian Dual-Use Export Forum” at the “GORS” concert hall on 7th September, it has been confirmed.

latvia.title: Berry good – Latvia's juiciest exports have growth potential
latvia.description: Latvia's berry exports are growing – in recent years, blackcurrant exports have reached a historically high level, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs heads to Lithuania
latvia.description: Just a couple of weeks after heading north to visit Estonia, on July 15th President Edgars Rinkēvičs is heading south to visit Latvia's southern neighbour and fellow Baltic state, Lithuania.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 14th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Projections suggest significant population shrinkage for Latvia over next 25 years
latvia.description: Latvia's population is set to shrink substantially over the next few decades, according to Eurostat regional data published on July 14th.

latvia.title: Railway worker's remains found on Rīga island
latvia.description: The remains of a 'Latvijas dzelzceļš' (Latvian Railways) employee who fell into the Daugava River and went missing on Friday were found on Zaķusala island in Riga on Tuesday afternoon, police confirmed.

latvia.title: School's out: Latvian examination results similar to last year
latvia.description: The average results of centralized exams in primary education this year have not changed significantly compared to the previous school year, and 818 students have not passed a single exam. In secondary school, the results of centralized exams in Latvian and English have improved, but secondary school students have also shown worse results in mathematics, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: New VAT rules seem to be applied properly in Latvia
latvia.description: The Consumer Rights Protection Center (PTAC) has concluded that recently-introduced changes to value added tax (VAT, or PVN in Latvian) rates on four food product groups (eggs, milk, fresh poultry meat and bread), have in general been applied fairly by retailers.

latvia.title: Research institute merger forms new Latvian science centre
latvia.description: A National Institute of Research and Innovation (NIRI) has been established in Latvia by merging the Latvian Institute of Organic Synthesis and the Latvian Biomedical Research and Study Centre. Institute representatives believe that the merger will accelerate the development and implementation of new medicines, diagnostic methods and medical technologies, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Latvia joins call for EU to cut funding to International Olympic Committee
latvia.description: Latvia is one of at least eight European countries that will address the European Commission with a proposal to withdraw European Union (EU) funding for the International Olympic Committee (IOC) as a result of its attempts to rehabilite aggressor states Russia and Belarus in international competition.

latvia.title: Latvia's way with surnames can cause problems in other countries
latvia.description: In today's dynamic and global world, when borders between countries are becoming increasingly blurred and when Latvian citizens form families with citizens of other countries, travel and live all over the world, the rendering of surnames is an issue that can cause a number of problems.

latvia.title: Latvia's honorary consuls in Ukraine given awards
latvia.description: On Monday, July 13th, Minister of Defense Raivis Melnis met with Latvia's honorary consuls in Ukraine to present them with awards.

lithuania.description: Președintele Lituaniei, Gitanas Nauseda, afirmă că informațiile serviciilor secrete indică faptul că Rusia ar putea planifica provocări în Polonia sau în țările baltice, menite să testeze unitatea NATO, relatează Reuters și LRT.

lithuania.title: VIDEO ⟩ Venemaa lennukid ei suutnud peatada Ukraina meredroone ja tabamuse said kaks naftatankerit
lithuania.description: Ukraina Julgeolekuteenistus (SSU) teatas 16. juulil, et koostöös mereväega tabasid nende Mamai nime kandvad meredroonid Mustal merel kahte tankerit – Louise 1 ja Banda. Ukraina andmetel kuuluvad mõlemad niinimetatud Venemaa varilaevastikku.

lithuania.title: REIN LANG ⟩ Rahvusooperi eestvedajad meenutavad burlakke Volgal
lithuania.description: Iga järjekordne uudis rahvusooper Estonia kohta toob mulle silme ette ukraina päritolu maalikunstniku Ilja Repini 1873. aasta maali «Burlakid Volgal». Sellel on kujutatud mehi, kes veavad köite abil vastuvoolu pargast. Ebainimlik töö. Aga mille poolest erinevad maalil kujutatud õnnetud neist, kes läbi ajaloo lohistavad vastuvoolu enda järel probleemi nimega rahvusooper, küsib Eesti Ringhäälingute Liidu juht Rein Lang (Reformierakond).

lithuania.title: ANALÜÜS ⟩ Kuidas tuleb Ukraina välja kriisist, mille põhjustas Zelenskõi otsus vallandada kaitseminister?
lithuania.description: Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi algatas valitsusevahetuse, kuid ei näe uue kabinetis kohta kaitseminister Mõhhailo Fedorovile. See ajas ukrainlased vihale ja tõi nad tänavale. Küsimus on, kas parlamendis saadakse kokku hääled uue kaitseministri ametisse kinnitamiseks ja kuidas Ukraina sellest kriisist nüüd välja tuleb?

lithuania.title: Rinkēvičs: Latvia and Lithuanuia share 'a bond based on bloodline'
lithuania.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs continues his two-day visit to Lithuania on July 16th, as previously reported.

lithuania.title: Baltics and Poland warn again about potential Russian provocations
lithuania.description: Lithuania has intelligence information indicating that Russia may be preparing to carry out provocations of some sort in the Baltic region, Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda said in an interview with the BNS news agency.

lithuania.title: LRT: Lithuania considering reintroducing checks on Latvian border
lithuania.description: Lithuania's incoming Interior Minister Martynas Katelynas has not ruled out temporarily reintroducing border controls with Latvia as the number of migrants arriving from Belarus via Latvia continues to increase. Compared with the first half of last year, secondary migration from Latvia has risen fourfold, reports Lithuanian public media LRT.

lithuania.title: President Rinkēvičs heads to Lithuania
lithuania.description: Just a couple of weeks after heading north to visit Estonia, on July 15th President Edgars Rinkēvičs is heading south to visit Latvia's southern neighbour and fellow Baltic state, Lithuania.

lithuania.title: NATO ir gatava, un reakcija būtu nevis stundās, bet minūtēs: Kudors un Rajevskis par iespējamu Krievijas provokāciju
lithuania.description: Pēc Polijas premjerministra Donalda Tuska brīdinājumiem par iespējamu Krievijas apdraudējumu Polijai un Baltijas valstīm arvien aktuālāks kļūst jautājums, vai Maskava varētu mēģināt provocēt NATO, lai pārbaudītu alianses vienotību. Politologu Anda Kudora un Filipa Rajevska vērtējumā šādu scenāriju pilnībā izslēgt nevar, taču Krievijas cerības uz NATO vājuma demonstrāciju varētu beigties ar pretēju rezultātu. lithuania.title: Putina “karš uz izsīkumu” pavēršas pret pašu? Slaidiņš atklāj Ukrainas stratēģisko mērķi Krimā
lithuania.description: Ukrainas spēki turpina uzbrukumus Krievijas militārajai infrastruktūrai okupētajā Krimā, un viens no Kijivas stratēģiskajiem mērķiem ir panākt pilnīgu uguns kontroli pār pussalu, TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” norāda NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš. lithuania.title: Krievija cenšas pārbaudīt NATO? Baltijas līderi brīdina par iespējamām provokācijām
lithuania.description: Latvijas un Lietuvas prezidenti brīdinājuši par iespējamu Krievijas gatavošanos uzbrukumiem kritiskās infrastruktūras objektiem Baltijas valstīs un Polijā, atsaucoties uz izlūkdienestu sniegto informāciju, vēsta “Euronews”. Jau iepriekš ziņojām, ka Latvijas prezidents Edgars Rinkēvičs brīdinājis – Krievija varētu mēģināt pārbaudīt NATO reakciju un kolektīvās aizsardzības mehānismus, turpinoties karam Ukrainā. Līdzīgus satraukumus paudis arī Lietuvas prezidents Gitans Nausēda, […]

lithuania.title: Uzņēmējs par Latvijas robežu: Nedrīkst neviena pele te izskriet cauri, bet mēs cīnāmies vieni!
lithuania.description: Latvijas austrumu robežai ar Krieviju un Baltkrieviju būtu jābūt vienai no tehnoloģiski modernākajām vietām Eiropā, jo tā vienlaikus ir gan NATO, gan Eiropas Savienības ārējā robeža, tā uzskata BalticTravelnews.com direktors Aivars Mackevičs. TV24 raidījumā “Preses klubs” viņš uzsvēra, ka Latgalē būtu jāizmanto visas jaunākās tehnoloģijas, lai robežas drošība būtu maksimāli augstā līmenī. Pēc viņa teiktā, […]

lithuania.title: Kas vadīs Ukrainu grūtajā ziemas periodā? Zelenskis atklāj savu premjera kandidātu
lithuania.description: Piemērotākais Ukrainas premjerministra amata kandidāts ir valsts naftas un gāzes koncerna “Naftogaz Ukraini” vadītājs Serhijs Koreckis, trešdien paziņoja Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis. “Ja mums priekšā ir ziema, mums jāgatavojas. Mēs jau sen gatavojamies, bet prioritātes ir skaidras – sagatavošanās ziemai. Tāpēc Serhijs Koreckis pēc visām konsultācijām noteikti ir vislabāk sagatavotais cilvēks Ukrainas premjerministra amatam,” teica […]

lithuania.title: Zelenskis brīdina, ko Ukraina gatavo Krievijai: “Mums būs 20 miljoni!”
lithuania.description: Ukraina pārvērš dronu ražošanu par vienu no galvenajiem kara industrijas balstiem – pašlaik valsts gadā saražo 10 miljonus bezpilota lidaparātu, bet nākotnē šo skaitu plānots dubultot līdz 20 miljoniem, ziņo “Dialog.UA”. Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis paziņojis par strauju valsts dronu ražošanas pieaugumu. Viņš norādīja, ka Ukraina jau spēj saražot 10 miljonus bezpilota lidaparātu gadā un […]

lithuania.title: Tramps par Putinu un kara beigām: “Domāju, ka viņš ir gatavs noslēgt vienošanos”
lithuania.description: ASV prezidents Donalds Tramps intervijā telekanālam “Fox News” paziņojis, ka uzskata Krievijas diktatoru Vladimiru Putinu par gatavu miera vienošanās panākšanai Ukrainas jautājumā. Tomēr šie izteikumi izskanējuši laikā, kad Krievija turpina uzbrukumus Ukrainai un parādās ziņas, ka Kremlis varētu gatavoties turpmākai kara eskalācijai. “Es domāju, ka viņš ir gatavs noslēgt vienošanos,” sacīja Tramps, atbildot uz jautājumu […]

lithuania.title: Ukraina apdovanojo Keirą Starmerį Laisvės ordinu
lithuania.description: Ukraina ketvirtadienį apdovanojo Jungtinės Karalystės (JK) ministrą pirmininką Keirą Starmerį (Kirą Starmerį) Laisvės ordinu.

lithuania.title: „Aš atsisakiau“: pasitraukiantis Ukrainos ministras trenkė durimis
lithuania.description: Ukrainos prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis pasiūlė besitraukiančiam gynybos ministrui Mychailai Fedorovui patarėjo pareigas, tačiau šis atsisakė.

lithuania.title: Tamsi kepurė – ne vien galvos apdangalas: užsimaskavusio pirkėjo ieško Kauno policija
lithuania.description: Pareigūnai aiškinasi, kas nesusimokėjo už prekes, prašoma ir visuomenės pagalbos.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis: prezidentas karo metu neturėtų rinktis tokioje situacijoje
lithuania.description: Ukrainos lyderis Volodymyras Zelenskis ketvirtadienį paragino kariuomenės vadovybę vienytis, sulaukęs kritikos dėl populiaraus šalies gynybos ministro, susipriešinusio su kariuomenės vyriausiuoju vadu, atleidimo.

lithuania.title: Latvijos prezidentui Edgarui Rinkevičiui – Klaipėdos universiteto garbės daktaro vardas
lithuania.description: Ketvirtadienį iškilmingame Klaipėdos universiteto Senato posėdyje Latvijos Respublikos Prezidentui Edgarui Rinkevičiui įteiktos Klaipėdos universiteto garbės daktaro regalijos.

lithuania.title: Už šnipinėjimą Baltarusijai sėdintis lietuvis, manoma, tapo reketo auka: prireikė net perkelti į kitą kalėjimą
lithuania.description: Liepos 16 dieną Kauno apylinkės teisme vienas prieš kitą stojo du pagarsėję nusikaltėliai – už šnipinėjimą Baltarusijai nuteistas Mantas Danielius bei ne kartą prieš tai teistas kikbokso čempionas, buvusios Kauno teisėjos sūnus Rolandas Agrba. Šių vyrų keliai susikirto įkalinimo įstaigoje. Manoma, kad R.Agrba už grotų reketavo M.Danielių, šį dėl saugumo užtikrinimo net teko perkelti į kitą kalėjimą.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis mano, kad Mychaila Fedorovas liks jo komandoje
lithuania.description: Ukrainos prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis pareiškė esąs įsitikinęs, kad buvęs gynybos ministras Mychaila Fedorovas liks jo komandoje, tačiau dėl galutinio tolesnio bendradarbiavimo formato jie susitars vėliau.

lithuania.title: Lietuvos pareigūnas 27 km persekiojo įtariamųjų migrantų grupę: pėdsakais vedė Moka
lithuania.description: Iš Baltarusijos į Latviją įsibrovusių neteisėtų migrantų grupę 27 km sekė ir sulaikė Neringos užkardos kinologas su belgų avigane Moka, pasakoja VSAT.

lithuania.title: Orbano ministras pradėjo dirbti Kinijos bendrovėje – Magyaras skėlė kaip reikiant
lithuania.description: Ilgametis Vengrijos diplomatas Peteris Szijjarto trečiadienį pasitraukė iš politikos, kad užimtų aukštas vadovaujančias pareigas Kinijos elektromobilių gamintojo BYD kompanijoje.

lithuania.title: Minint Sausumos pajėgų dieną Trakų pilies kieme – žygio vėliavų perdavimo ceremonija
lithuania.description: Trakų salos pilies kieme ketvirtadienį minint Sausumos pajėgų dieną vyko žygio vėliavų perdavimo ceremonija.

lithuania.title: Varšuvoje užkirstas kelias retų papūgų kontrabandai
lithuania.description: Lenkijos muitinės pareigūnai nelegalioje siuntoje rado 20 egzotiškų papūgų, sugrūstų į lagaminą.

lithuania.title: Rusijos verslus kapoja mirtis: paskelbė skaičius
lithuania.description: Ekonomikos nuosmukis, mokesčių didinimas ir rekordiškai aukšta Centrinio banko bazinė palūkanų norma paskatino staigų Rusijos įmonių bankrotų skaičiaus kilimą.

lithuania.title: Trumpas kreipsis į tautą: „Turiu tikrai, tikrai didelių naujienų“
lithuania.description: JAV prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas ketvirtadienio vakarą kreipsis į tautą temomis, kurios, pasak jo, apims rinkimus ir balsavimo mašinas.

lithuania.title: „Maniau, kad tai tas didysis žemės drebėjimas, apie kurį įspėjo“: Naujojoje Zelandijoje atšauktas cunamio pavojus
lithuania.description: Naujosios Zelandijos pareigūnai ketvirtadienį atšaukė cunamio pavojų, paskelbtą po 5,9 balo stiprumo žemės drebėjimo vakarinėje Pietų salos pakrantėje.

lithuania.title: Prokuratūra ėmėsi tyrimo dėl „Facebook“ įrašo: vertinami galimi raginimai veikti prieš Lietuvą
lithuania.description: Generalinė prokuratūra pradėjo ikiteisminį tyrimą, kurio metu bus vertinamas 2026 m. liepos 1 d. socialinio tinklo „Facebook“ paskyroje, pavadinimu „Celofano mobingas“, paskelbtas tekstas lietuvių ir rusų kalbomis, rašoma prokuratūros pranešime žiniasklaidai.

lithuania.title: Jurgita Šukevičienė. Jau metas nustatyti, kokio amžiaus vaikai gali naudotis socialiniais tinklais
lithuania.description: Kiekvieną vasarą tėvai susiduria su tuo pačiu iššūkiu – pasibaigus mokslo metams vaikai daugiau laiko praleidžia su draugais ir, žinoma, skaitmeninėje erdvėje. Telefonu, planšete, ar kompiuteriu pasiekiami socialiniai tinklai – vaikų kasdienybė.

lithuania.title: EK vadovė sveikina naująjį Ukrainos premjerą ir viliasi tęsti bendradarbiavimą
lithuania.description: Europos Komisijos (EK) pirmininkė Ursula von der Leyen (Urzula fon der Lajen) ketvirtadienį pasveikino naująjį Ukrainos ministrą pirmininką Serhijų Koreckį pradėjus eiti pareigas ir pareiškė, kad tikisi „tęsti mūsų puikų bendradarbiavimą“ su Kyjivu.

lithuania.title: ES teismas paliko galioti Ispanijos amnestijos Katalonijos separatistams įstatymą
lithuania.description: Europos Sąjungos Teisingumo Teismas (ESTT) ketvirtadienį įteikė simbolinę pergalę Ispanijos ministrui pirmininkui Pedro Sanchezui, palikęs galioti jo ginčijamą 2024 metų amnestijos įstatymą Katalonijos separatistams, dalyvavusiems nepavykusiame regiono bandyme atsiskirti.

lithuania.title: 18-metis ir 20-metis programišiai atakavo Londono transporto sistemą – sės už grotų 5,5 metų
lithuania.description: Jungtinės Karalystės (JK) teismas ketvirtadienį skyrė laisvės atėmimo bausmes dviem jaunuoliams dėl 2024 metais įvykdytos kibernetinės atakos prieš Londono viešojo transporto operatorių, per kurią buvo nutekinti milijonų klientų duomenys ir kuri tapo vienu didžiausių duomenų saugumo pažeidimų šalyje.

lithuania.title: Atleistas Ukrainos gynybos ministras kaltina kariuomenės vadą bandymu suskaldyti šalį
lithuania.description: Atleistas Ukrainos gynybos ministras Mychaila Fedorovas ketvirtadienį apkaltino vyriausiąjį kariuomenės vadą Oleksandrą Syrskį bandymu suskaldyti karo draskomą šalį.
